name: Dead Meat
source:
No one's safe, not really. Not even in the comfort of your own home.

When your mundane life gets shattered in the span of one day due to a cannibal, what are you to do? Dead Meat has been [i]dying[/i] to meet you.

[From [url=https://deadmeatvn.itch.io/dead-meat-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
没有人真正安全，即使待在自己舒适的家中，也不例外。

当一个食人者在短短一天之内摧毁了你平凡的生活，你该怎么办？《Dead Meat》已经想见你想得[i]要死[/i]了。

[摘自[url=https://deadmeatvn.itch.io/dead-meat-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
